title: News clip: Victory Learning Center employees put on leave
place_text: Victory Learning Center, Lackawanna, New York

tellings.quote: OLV Human Services says three employees at the Victory Learning Center in Lacawana are now on leave over those allegations of physically mistreating students.

plain: A local news report played on the show says that OLV Human Services, which runs the Victory Learning Center in Lackawanna, New York, put three employees there on leave over "allegations of physically mistreating students". The clip comes up in an interview with a guest who says he was taken into a UFO programme as a child, and it is shown as outside record that harm happened at a school tied to his story.
